title: node/switch
description: Route to exactly one node. Rules are tried in order over this node's inputs; the first that holds names the node that runs, else the fallback. Every other candidate, and everything reachable only through it, is cancelled. Expressions: has(path), comparisons, && || !, len(x).

type.description: Marks this node a switch: it routes to exactly one node.

description.description: What this node decides, for a reader of the graph.

label.description: A short human name for this node, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its id.

rules.description: The rules, tried in order over this node's inputs. The first that holds names the node that runs.

when.description: The condition, an expression over this node's inputs that must answer a boolean (G011).

description.description: What this rule decides, for a reader of the graph.
